artworks.title: Donkey Upset by Storm (L'ane renverse par la foudre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and woman struggling against a strong wind beneath a tree. The woman is wearing a billowing garment, while the man is holding onto his hat. Beside them, a tired donkey lies on the ground with a sack on its back. The horizon is not clearly defined, merging with the cross-hatched texture of the etching. The sky above is dark and dramatic, hinting at an impending storm, contrasting with the lighter tones of the ground and figures. The play of light and shadow creates a vivid atmosphere in the monochromatic image.

artworks.title: Thunder (Un coup de foudre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in motion, bending slightly forward and holding onto a tree or bush with both hands. Her facial features are not clearly detailed due to the sketch style. Her head is turned, with the expression obscured. She has dark, textured hair styled in a bun or another form. She wears a long dress reaching her ankles that flows as she moves. There is no visible jewelry or objects she holds aside from the tree or foliage. The background features a wooded area with large trees and abundant foliage. The art style includes intricate crosshatching for depth and shadow, suggesting a dense environment.

artworks.title: In the Forest of Fontainebleau  (Dans la foret de Fontainebleau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch-like scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, depicting a landscape dominated by a line of trees. The horizon is low in the image, just above a rising slope, with tall trees extending towards the sky. The trees and foliage are characterized by brushstrokes and crosshatching technique, conveying texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark and light tones for a serene, natural quality. Line and shadow add movement and highlight the beauty of the trees as they recede into the distance, merging with the sky.

artworks.title: Drinking Trough, 2nd plate (L'abreuvoir)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene with a slightly elevated point of view. In the foreground, a seated figure wearing a hat is partially obscured by a horse standing beside them. The horse's contours are delicately rendered, curving towards the right. A thatched-roof building fills the center and right of the image, with a window letting in light. The artwork features dense, cross-hatched lines for texture and shadow, creating a monochromatic palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: Women of Brussels (Femmes de Bruges)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures sitting closely in a line. They are all shown from head to foot, with their heads slightly lowered and facing to the right. Their facial features are obscured by the hoods of their robes. Each figure wears a long robe with a hood covering most of their hair and framing their face. Their hands are visible, with some figures gesturing subtly. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Hector Berlioz
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an elderly man. He is shown from the waist up, facing the viewer with a calm expression. The man has distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes, a strong nose, and a furrowed brow. His hair is wavy and mostly white or grey. He is dressed in a formal outfit with a suit jacket, a shirt, and a tie or cravat. The background is plain, and the artwork is attributed to "A. Legros" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Edge of a Forest in Bourgogne (Un coin de foret en Bourgogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a figure pushing a wheelbarrow filled with logs. Trees are depicted to the left of the figure, and the horizon blends into a sky filled with swirling cloud-like etchings. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette and expressive strokes to convey movement and texture.

artworks.title: Rectory Wall (Le mur du presbytere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a slightly elevated perspective. There are trees, a structure resembling a ruined tower or castle, and a rustic house with a sloped roof in the mid-distance. The brushwork is fine and detailed, resembling etching. The palette is monochromatic with dark lines on a light background. A figure in simple garments is kneeling on a path near yoked oxen. The path leads into the distance, showing a mix of human and natural elements.

artworks.title: Along the River (Le long de la rive)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a low horizon line, a lone figure sitting under a group of trees, and a sky above. The trees are detailed with fine, textured strokes and frame the left and central parts of the composition. The etching style uses flowing lines for the foliage and ground. The color scheme is monochromatic in soft sepia and cream, creating a serene atmosphere. In the distance, there are faint landscape features, emphasizing the interaction between the natural elements and the figure.

artworks.title: Avenue of Poplars (L'allee de peupliers)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint, showcasing a gently curving landmass. The horizon is high in the frame, with clusters of trees and foliage. The brushstrokes or etching lines create movement and texture on the trees and ground. The color palette is monochrome, likely black and gray on a cream background. The ground shows light texture, possibly indicating grass. The trees in the background provide depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Poplars near Amiens (Pres d'Amiens, les tourbieres)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water in the foreground, surrounded by vegetation and a small wooden structure. Tall trees line the horizon under a pale sky. The etching style uses fine lines for texture, with a sepia color palette giving it an antique look.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan (Le bon samaritain)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a reclining position on the ground. The person in the foreground is lying flat on their back with slightly bent legs. The person behind them is sitting and leaning over, with a slightly hunched body. Their facial features are unclear, and their hair is long and wavy. Both figures are dressed in loose garments resembling robes. The background hints at an outdoor setting with foliage, a tree-like form, and a horse standing nearby. There are lines and shading suggesting a natural landscape with shrubs or vegetation in the distance.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's face with distinctive features, including deep-set eyes, a high forehead, a bushy beard connected to a mustache, and long wavy hair framing his face. He is shown straight on, wearing a collared outfit. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of an older man. He is depicted in a frontal position, showcasing his facial features such as deep-set eyes, furrowed brows, a straight nose, long beard, mustache, and wavy hair that falls past his ears. The drawing is in pencil with hatching and cross-hatching for shading and texture. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject's features and expression.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter, 4th plate (La mort et le bucheron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in an outdoor setting. The first person is fully visible, sitting on the ground with their legs bent and arms resting on their knees, holding a bundle of sticks. This figure is older, with a bare head showing a receding hairline and a thick beard. They are wearing simple, rough-looking clothing with sleeves rolled up, and knee-length pants. The second figure is partially visible and is positioned leaning against a stone structure, wearing a hooded robe that obscures their facial features and holding a scythe. The background consists of tall, slender tree trunks and branches with some foliage visible, set in a softly rendered, sketch-like technique suggestive of a shaded woodland environment.

artworks.title: L'heureuse fécondité
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edwin Wolf, II
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a gathering around a woman holding a child in her arms in an indoor setting with stone columns and an arched background. Another woman is next to her, looking towards her while leaning over what appears to be a child or possibly a doll on a small donkey. Surrounding the central woman are several children, some seated and playing on the floor. A dog is resting at the central woman's feet. The image features lush drapery, creating a warm and intimate setting. The style suggests classical or historical fashion, and there is an ornate border with ivy leaves. The text and emblem below likely contain relevant inscriptions.

artworks.title: Two Satyrs Fighting about a Nymph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three nude figures in a complex and textured environment. The figures are intertwined, with one holding a club above its head. Another figure is supporting a third with draped hair. The background is filled with detailed foliage, creating depth without shading. The composition suggests a dramatic scene reminiscent of early Renaissance or late Medieval art.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is a painting of an elaborate procession in a classical setting. The artwork depicts a detailed scene with numerous figures in draped garments and armor, suggesting a parade or gathering. In the background, a building facade with distinct architectural details such as relief carvings and an ornately decorated column is observable. Above the heads of the figures, a banner and a Roman standard are being held. The figures include males, females, and children who are illustrated with expressive faces and intricate clothing patterns. The artistry focuses on line work and shading reminiscent of classical Renaissance style.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. It features a central figure on a cross, flanked by two figures on either side, set against the backdrop of a hill with a cityscape in the background. The figures are surrounded by intricate line work and decorative elements. The central figure has a halo, with drip-like lines coming from the hands and feet. Above the cross, an inscription reads "INRI." The scene includes a sun and moon in the sky, each with a face. The image is framed by ornate pillars, and at the base, there is a skull and bones. The style resembles late medieval or early renaissance woodcut illustrations with detailed borders.

artworks.title: Three Marys at the Tomb
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The painting depicts a complex narrative scene with various figures engaged in different activities on a hillside. The image has a medieval illustration style, reminiscent of works from the late Middle Ages or early Renaissance. Various individuals are interacting with each other, with some standing and others reclining on the ground. Buildings are visible in the background to the left under a shining sun, while the skyline features rolling hills with pathways leading among them. Groups of figures appear in traditional clothing, some with head coverings, while a solitary figure points at another or gestures. A couple of figures in iron armor lie on the ground.

artworks.title: A Covered Street in Cairo (Eene overdekte straat in Cairo)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling alley or marketplace. The drawing shows an alleyway filled with people gathered in groups and individuals walking through. The architecture has arched doorways and narrow pathways, and has intricate details suggesting a historical or traditional setting. Overhead, there are awnings and fabric providing shade, casting shadows that add depth and texture to the scene. The perspective leads the viewer's eye deeper into the alley. The use of shading and crosshatching captures the textures of the environment and the movement within this dynamic, confined space.

artworks.title: Erasmus
artworks.artist: Félix Bracquemond after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark

artworks.title: The Master-Smith
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The etching portrays a man shown from the waist up, slightly bent forward with his arms resting on a table or workbench. His facial features are marked by deep lines and shadows, with a prominent nose and a focused expression beneath a hat that shadows his eyes. He has a long, bushy beard and wears round glasses. The man is dressed in a vest over a shirt with long sleeves. In his hands, he holds a tool or object. The setting is dimly lit, with heavy cross-hatching shading. The background features undefined tools or objects.

artworks.title: La Piera del Bando. V.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows a view from Piazza San Marco in Venice towards the Palace, displaying Gothic architectural details. The scene captures a plaza with people in period clothing, some conversing or resting. Vertical elements like statues and columns lead the eye towards distant domes and architecture. The artistic style features fine linework, typical of etching, detailing stone textures and human activity. The color palette is monochromatic with dark ink on a light background, providing a historical and elegant look with shading for depth and form.
